_sources.workload.site_names: T14-SOAK-ROUTE: five normal accounts use woodcutting.falador_west.n and fifteen oak accounts use woodcutting.falador_west.2, with Falador West bank. Five radius-five normal Starts each require two eligible, reachable trees and a five-tree capacity matching, not a product assignment. The selected revision-289 oak site has region x=2886..2932,z=3350..3412 and three oaks; Start (2925,3367,0) at radius 12 includes the three placements (crates/api/data/game-data/289.json gather_sites; content/maps/m45_52.jm2:5249,5313,5384). Oak census square: x=2913..2937,z=3355..3379. Outer bound: x=2840..3065,z=3262..3527. Main's Chance outcomes ruling limits the route proof to workload worksite-bank travel, Gatherer retreats and re-approaches, and fault recovery. Guardian flee and event-derived ordinary replans are outside that proof. A departure started by an observed owned random event is recorded with its events, not stopped by the boundary oracle. Attribution clears on safe re-entry. Workload departures still fail on hunter envelopes or the outer boundary. Only requirement-free, adjacent, same-level ordinary gates or doors may pass the workload route check. Qualification requires a passing workload audit, a completed bank cycle for every account, and the five-pair aggregate verdict.
_sources.workload.food: T14-SOAK-DIAG-1102/site-safety-preflight.json:10-16 reports zero aggressive-envelope intersections in the oak radius-12 square and a nearest-envelope margin of 9 tiles. Revision-289 NPC id 172 at (2910,3337) has forced_max_hit 6, while Lobster item 379 heals 12 Hitpoints (crates/api/data/game-data/289.json npc_placements.rows, npc_names.rows and consumption). Seed one Lobster in each account's inventory plus one bank replacement; foodTarget=1. One carried Lobster heals twice the nearest static hunter's max hit. eatBelow=0 retains Gatherer's automatic half-base-HP threshold (crates/script/src/gatherer/runner.rs:1860-1863). Static scan only; dynamic threats, actual routes, interactions and bank/yield rate remain unproved.
